scope: Independent design re-review of I1-I3 and changed sections only

findings.basis: The scoped grammar permits an optional await operand and initial keyword this while requiring a complete visible statement, full dotted callee and final Name token. The captured donor projection costs 5441 of 5998 characters. Lines 71-74 contain the complete dispatch, and the Python executor at L352 fits the retained tail. Planned independent-name positives, omitted/unfinished negatives and actual validator tests constrain the whitelist. The proof establishes visibility and token shapes only.

A trusted latch is checked before the next inner generate and on normal return. The real NativeReAct loop executes one action synchronously per generation. A false END, timeout or missing matching success stops further generation and dispatch. Real event metadata and any earlier effects survive. The bad-span-then-would-be-valid-write test asserts one failed dispatch, zero new generations and zero intents. Preflight exceptions stay tied to their actual request-bound call IDs.

START before worker submission provides conservative pending state. The nested report writer marks intent only after full validation/path checks, before FileWriteTool.execute. RLock-backed state links a single outstanding report, binding, dispatch and actual adapter IDs. Normal pre-intent rejection is distinguishable from timeout, outer loss, post-intent error and confirmed write. An unresolved timeout remains possible even when the marker has not arrived. Detached snapshot and separately timed path-checked readback preserve uncertainty and cross-request isolation. Planned error/barrier tests cover both sides of intent without extending ordinary file handling or promising cancellation.

scope_note: No tests, inference, network, UI, product edits, queue or release action. Design stage only. Previous three failed repairs retained.
